verdict.rationale: v0 has a documented Platform API that exposes its generation, chat, project and deployment capabilities. The SDK repo includes copyable code examples such as v0.chats.create and readV0Stream, and the docs are also served as machine-readable markdown. Nothing shows an interactive explorer or in-browser runnable examples. Missing for 10: an interactive API reference, in-docs runnable or try-it examples, endpoint-level reference detail, and independent corroboration.
